examples.suggested: 더 높은 한도를 부여하는 라이선스를 취득하지 않는 한, 이 Qiskit Function은 최대 20큐비트가 필요한 문제에만 사용할 수 있습니다.
examples.translation: 이 Qiskit Function의 사용은 최대 20큐비트가 필요한 문제로 제한되며, 더 높은 한도를 부여하는 라이선스를 취득하지 않는 한 그러합니다.
examples.why: The English trailing "unless" clause is transplanted verbatim, forcing the dangling "…그러합니다" tail, which no Korean technical writer would produce; Korean puts the condition first. The condition itself is correct, so this is stiffness, not drift.

examples.source: The PES curve is shown with the FCI reference and initial guess from RHF, together with the energy error from the FCI reference.
examples.suggested: PES 곡선은 FCI 참조값 및 RHF 초기 추정값과 함께 표시되며, FCI 참조값 대비 에너지 오차도 함께 나타냈습니다.
examples.translation: PES 곡선은 FCI 참조 및 RHF의 초기 추정과 함께 FCI 참조로부터의 에너지 오차와 함께 표시됩니다.
examples.why: "~와 함께 … ~와 함께" repeats the same connective twice in one sentence, a direct calque of "with … together with"; it reads as machine output even though the content is right.

examples.source: assuming you've already saved your account to your local environment
examples.suggested: 이미 로컬 환경에 계정을 저장했다고 가정하면
examples.translation: 이미 계정을 저장했다고 가정하면
examples.why: The qualifier "to your local environment" is dropped, so the reader is not told where the account must be saved. A minor lost detail, not a changed claim.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, dropped caveats or swapped quantities; the group-theory setup (koset, subkumpulan penstabil-graf, "baris 15, lajur 20"), the O(N²)/N(N+1)/2 counts and the fidelity comparison all track the English exactly. The main defect is within-file term splitting: "circuit" is left raw English in ~9 places ("Circuit abstrak", "circuit tindihan", "pensampelan circuit", "circuit ditranspil") while the correct Malay "litar" is used in the learning outcomes and Background ("Pembinaan litar kernel kuantum", "litar kuantum"), and "Backend" is even capitalised mid-sentence in the Step 2 bullet. Two term renderings are literal-but-wrong: "shot noise" → "bunyi tembakan" (reads as "the sound of a gunshot"; the physics term is "hingar tembakan"/"hingar sampel"), and "special unitary group" → "kumpulan unit istimewa", where "unit" should be "uniter" — as written it names a different algebraic object, though SU(2) and the 2×2-matrix gloss keep it recoverable. Minor translationese also survives in "kita berjalan melalui empat langkah" (calque of "we walk through") and "kita oleh itu menjalankan".

examples.source: Abstract circuit for calculating a kernel matrix entry. / the overlap circuit
examples.suggested: Litar abstrak untuk mengira entri matriks kernel. / litar tindihan
examples.translation: Circuit abstrak untuk mengira entri matriks kernel. / circuit tindihan
examples.why: "circuit" is left in English in roughly nine places while the same file correctly uses "litar" in the learning outcomes and Background sections ("Pembinaan litar kernel kuantum", "litar kuantum", "litar kuantum yang digunakan untuk menilai satu entri"). Same concept, two renderings, split along section boundaries — the classic two-pass-merge inconsistency.

examples.source: A statevector simulator is exact (up to shot noise)
examples.suggested: Simulator statevector adalah tepat (setakat hingar tembakan)
examples.translation: Simulator statevector adalah tepat (sehingga bunyi tembakan)
examples.why: "bunyi tembakan" is the everyday phrase for the audible sound of a gunshot, not the statistical sampling term. Malay physics/engineering register uses "hingar" for noise. "sehingga" is also the wrong sense of "up to" here (it reads as "until"); "setakat" carries the intended "limited only by".

examples.source: which is the special unitary group of 2 × 2 matrices
examples.suggested: iaitu kumpulan uniter khas bagi matriks 2 × 2
examples.translation: iaitu kumpulan unit istimewa daripada matriks 2 × 2
examples.why: "unitary" is rendered as "unit", not "uniter". "Kumpulan unit" names a different algebraic object (the group of units of a ring), so the term as written points away from SU(2); the surrounding formula and the 2×2 gloss keep it recoverable, which is why this is minor rather than misleading.

examples.source: we walk through the four steps of the Qiskit pattern
examples.suggested: kita menyusuri empat langkah corak Qiskit
examples.translation: kita berjalan melalui empat langkah corak Qiskit
examples.why: "berjalan melalui" is a word-for-word calque of "walk through" and reads as physical walking; a Malay technical writer would use "menyusuri", "meneliti satu per satu" or "melalui". Grammatical but unmistakably translated.

examples.source: Abstract circuit, not optimized for a particular backend.
examples.suggested: Litar abstrak, belum dioptimumkan untuk backend tertentu.
examples.translation: Circuit abstrak, belum dioptimumkan untuk Backend tertentu.
examples.why: "Backend" is capitalised mid-sentence, an artefact of English title-casing that Malay does not carry; the same word appears lowercase two lines later ("pengoptimuman khusus-backend").

editor_note: Two sentences say something the English does not. In the execution-modes paragraph, "A Job is a single query to a primitive that can be run over a specified number of shots" becomes "Kerja adalah pertanyaan tunggal kepada primitif yang boleh dijalankan **melebihi** bilangan tembakan tertentu" — "melebihi" means *exceeding*, so the learner is told a job runs beyond some shot count rather than *for* a specified number of shots; "tembakan" (gunshots) is also the wrong domain word for *shots* (syot / keep "shots"). In the Runtime paragraph, "return a higher-quality result from executing quantum circuits" becomes "menghasilkan keputusan berkualiti lebih tinggi **daripada** melaksanakan Circuit kuantum pada pemproses kuantum", which after a comparative adjective reads as "higher quality **than** executing quantum circuits on quantum processors" — the causal "from" is inverted into a comparison. Secondary: "streamlines quantum computations" is strengthened to "mempercepatkan" (speeds up); "circuit" is left as capitalised English "Circuit" mid-sentence ("melaksanakan Circuit kuantum", "mengambil Circuit abstrak") instead of "litar"; the three mode names are split (Job→"Kerja", Batch→"Kumpulan", but Session left English); "antrian" is Indonesian (Malay: baris gilir); and the file uses casual "kamu" throughout instead of "anda".

examples.source: A Job is a single query to a primitive that can be run over a specified number of shots.
examples.suggested: Job ialah satu pertanyaan tunggal kepada primitif yang boleh dijalankan untuk bilangan syot yang ditetapkan.
examples.translation: Kerja adalah pertanyaan tunggal kepada primitif yang boleh dijalankan melebihi bilangan tembakan tertentu.
examples.why: "melebihi" = exceeding, turning "run over/for N shots" into "run beyond N shots"; teaches a false idea of what shots specify. "tembakan" (gunshot) is also the wrong domain term.

examples.source: ...to return a higher-quality result from executing quantum circuits on quantum processors.
examples.suggested: ...untuk menghasilkan hasil yang lebih berkualiti apabila melaksanakan litar kuantum pada pemproses kuantum.
examples.translation: ...untuk menghasilkan keputusan berkualiti lebih tinggi daripada melaksanakan Circuit kuantum pada pemproses kuantum.
examples.why: After "berkualiti lebih tinggi", "daripada" is read as the comparative "than", so the sentence claims the result is better *than* running circuits on QPUs rather than better *from* running them.

examples.source: The Qiskit Runtime service streamlines quantum computations...
examples.suggested: Perkhidmatan Qiskit Runtime memperkemas pengiraan kuantum...
examples.translation: Perkhidmatan Qiskit Runtime mempercepatkan pengiraan kuantum...
examples.why: "streamlines" (makes more efficient/simpler) is strengthened into a speed claim the English does not make.

examples.source: quantum circuits / abstract circuits
examples.suggested: litar kuantum / litar abstrak
examples.translation: Circuit kuantum / Circuit abstrak
examples.why: Generic "circuit" is left as capitalised English mid-sentence, a glossary keep-English rule misapplied to a common noun that Malay technical writing renders as "litar".

examples.source: [Job, Session, and Batch](/guides/execution-modes) ... the quantum job queue
examples.suggested: [Job, Session, dan Batch] ... baris gilir kerja kuantum
examples.translation: [Kerja, Session, dan Kumpulan] ... antrian kerja kuantum
examples.why: The three mode names are handled three different ways (two translated, one kept), and "antrian" is Indonesian rather than Malay "baris gilir".

editor_note: FAIL is driven by one misleading domain error: "we turn on error mitigation, including Zero Noise Extrapolation (ZNE)" is rendered as "włączamy korekcję błędów, w tym Ekstrapolację Zerowego Szumu (ZNE)" — "korekcja błędów" is *error correction* (QEC), a categorically different concept from *error mitigation* (poprawnie: "łagodzenie/mitygacja błędów"); a learner is taught that ZNE is a form of quantum error correction, which is false and is exactly the distinction this material should be sharpening. Separately, the file carries an unresolved glossary leak: "quantum circuit" and "backend" are left in English, capitalized mid-sentence and undeclined ("za pomocą Circuit kwantowego", "uruchamiamy Circuit kwantowy", "rozmiar Circuit", "Najpierw wybieramy Backend do użycia", heading "### Circuit kwantowy"), while "qubit" is spliced in camelCase ("jednoQubitowe zredukowane macierze gęstości", "jednoQubitowa RDM", "bramek dwuQubitowych") — grammatically broken Polish that no native technical writer would produce, though still recognizable. Finally, "near-term (quantum hardware/devices)" is calqued as "bliskich horyzontowi sprzętu kwantowego" / "urządzeń bliskich horyzontowi", which is not idiomatic Polish and barely parses; and "global state overlaps" becomes "globalnych przekryć stanów" ("przekrycie" instead of the usual "przekrywanie się / nakładanie stanów"). Register is correctly informal ("Zwróć uwagę", "Możesz pominąć tę sekcję", "przeprowadziłeś/aś") and the Appendix reasoning about √N, geometric separation and model complexity is rendered faithfully.

examples.source: Note that we turn on error mitigation, including Zero Noise Extrapolation (ZNE).
examples.suggested: Zwróć uwagę, że włączamy łagodzenie błędów (error mitigation), w tym ekstrapolację do zerowego szumu (ZNE).
examples.translation: Zwróć uwagę, że włączamy korekcję błędów, w tym Ekstrapolację Zerowego Szumu (ZNE).
examples.why: "Korekcja błędów" is quantum error CORRECTION — a different (and much stronger) concept than error mitigation. ZNE is a mitigation technique; calling it correction teaches the learner a false belief about what the Estimator options do and about the QEC/QEM distinction the field draws carefully.

examples.source: quantum circuit / circuit size / select the backend
examples.suggested: „za pomocą obwodu kwantowego", „### Obwód kwantowy", „rozmiar obwodu", „Najpierw wybieramy backend, którego użyjemy."
examples.translation: „za pomocą Circuit kwantowego", „### Circuit kwantowy", „uruchamiamy Circuit kwantowy", „rozmiar Circuit", „Najpierw wybieramy Backend do użycia."
examples.why: Untranslated, capitalized and undeclined English glossary leak ('Circuit', 'Backend') inside Polish sentences. 'rozmiar Circuit' has no case agreement at all. Recognizable, so not misleading, but it is not Polish; standard rendering is 'obwód kwantowy', and 'backend' at minimum lowercase and declined.

examples.source: single-qubit reduced density matrices (1 RDMs) / two-qubit gate depth
examples.suggested: „jednokubitowe zredukowane macierze gęstości", „jednokubitowa RDM", „bramek dwukubitowych"
examples.translation: „jednoQubitowe zredukowane macierze gęstości", „jednoQubitowa RDM", „jednoQubitowych pomiarów", „bramek dwuQubitowych"
examples.why: Mid-word capital from a mechanical qubit→Qubit substitution; Polish never capitalizes inside a compound adjective. Note the same file writes lowercase 'qubita'/'qubitów' in free text, so the rendering is also inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: particularly for near-term quantum hardware … while remaining more practical for near-term devices
examples.suggested: zwłaszcza dla sprzętu kwantowego najbliższej przyszłości (ery NISQ) … pozostając bardziej praktycznymi dla urządzeń najbliższej przyszłości
examples.translation: zwłaszcza w przypadku bliskich horyzontowi sprzętu kwantowego … pozostając jednocześnie bardziej praktycznymi dla urządzeń bliskich horyzontowi
examples.why: 'bliski horyzontowi' is a literal calque of 'near-term' that carries no established meaning in Polish and, in the first instance, is also grammatically mangled ('bliskich horyzontowi sprzętu'). A native writer would use 'najbliższej przyszłości' or the NISQ framing.

examples.source: Standard quantum kernels typically rely on estimating global state overlaps
examples.suggested: … na szacowaniu globalnego przekrywania się stanów (iloczynów skalarnych stanów)
examples.translation: Standardowe jądra kwantowe zazwyczaj polegają na szacowaniu globalnych przekryć stanów
examples.why: 'przekrycie' is not the conventional Polish rendering of state overlap; 'przekrywanie się stanów' or 'nakładanie się stanów' is what a Polish physicist writes. Recognizable, so minor, but it reads as a dictionary pick rather than domain usage.

examples.source: the data is transformed into a high-dimensional Hilbert space
examples.suggested: dane są przekształcane w wysokowymiarową przestrzeń Hilberta
examples.translation: dane są przekształcane w wielowymiarową przestrzeń Hilberta
examples.why: 'wielowymiarowa' means merely multi-dimensional and flattens the point the English is making — that the feature space is of *high* dimension, which is the whole motivation for the feature map. A dropped emphasis rather than a wrong statement.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the tensor/expand subsystem indexing (macierz $B$ → podsystem 0, macierz $A$ → podsystem 1), the `front=True` reversal, the unitarity caveat and the process-fidelity CP caveat are all rendered correctly, and informal "ty" holds (znajdziesz, Zauważ, Możesz też). The defects are glossary-leak artifacts, not drift: English class-like nouns survive untranslated and undeclined in running prose — "dla Circuit", "wywoływania Backend symulatora", "lub Gate, która nie posiada…", and the H2 "Używanie obiektów Operator w Circuit" — while the substituted Polish word is stuck in the nominative, producing ungrammatical "rozkładu na bramka z definicjami macierzowymi" (line 53) and twice "do obwód" instead of "do obwodu" (lines 124, 141). Qubit compounds are spelled three different ways in one file: "jednoQubitowych" (141, 167), "dwu-qubitową" and "trzy-qubitowym" (236) — none matches the standard "jednokubitowy / dwukubitowy / trzykubitowy". Two smaller items: the typo "wielkość teorioiformacyjna" (354, missing n) and "mnożenia skalarnego przez liczby zespolone" (286), which in Polish reads as the dot product rather than "mnożenie przez skalar".

examples.source: you can use the Operator class as a unitary simulator to compute the final unitary matrix for a quantum circuit, without having to call a simulator backend. If the circuit contains any unsupported operations… or a gate that does not have a matrix definition or decomposition in terms of gate with matrix definitions.
examples.suggested: …do obliczania końcowej macierzy unitarnej dla obwodu kwantowego, bez konieczności wywoływania backendu symulatora. Jeśli obwód zawiera nieobsługiwane operacje… lub bramka, która nie ma definicji macierzowej ani rozkładu na bramki z definicjami macierzowymi.
examples.translation: możesz używać klasy `Operator` jako symulatora unitarnego do obliczania końcowej macierzy unitarnej dla Circuit, bez konieczności wywoływania Backend symulatora. Jeśli Circuit zawiera nieobsługiwane operacje… lub Gate, która nie posiada definicji macierzowej ani rozkładu na bramka z definicjami macierzowymi.
examples.why: Three glossary leaks in one paragraph: 'Circuit', 'Backend' and 'Gate' stay in English and undeclined, and the substituted Polish noun is frozen in the nominative, giving the ungrammatical 'rozkładu na bramka'. A Polish reader can still recover the meaning, so it does not mislead, but no native technical writer would leave this.

examples.source: which is added to the circuit / may also be directly inserted into the circuit itself
examples.suggested: który jest dodawany do obwodu / można też wstawić bezpośrednio do obwodu
examples.translation: który jest dodawany do obwód / można też wstawić bezpośrednio do obwód
examples.why: Same nominative-freeze bug: the preposition 'do' requires the genitive 'obwodu'. Twice in the file, and it makes the sentence read as machine output rather than written Polish.

examples.source: single-qubit Pauli gates / single-qubit operators / a two-qubit gate with a three-qubit operator
examples.suggested: jednokubitowych bramek Pauli / operatorami jednokubitowymi / bramkę dwukubitową z operatorem trzykubitowym
examples.translation: jednoQubitowych bramek Pauli / operatorami jednoQubitowymi / bramkę dwu-qubitową z operatorem trzy-qubitowym
examples.why: The qubit compound is spelled three inconsistent ways within one file — camel-cased 'jednoQubitowych', hyphenated 'dwu-qubitową', 'trzy-qubitowym'. The concept stays identifiable, so MINOR, but the standard Polish form is the solid 'jedno-/dwu-/trzykubitowy'.

examples.source: This is an information-theoretic quantity for how close two quantum channels are to each other
examples.suggested: Jest to wielkość teorioinformacyjna określająca, jak bliskie sobie są dwa kanały kwantowe
examples.translation: Jest to wielkość teorioiformacyjna określająca, jak bliskie sobie są dwa kanały kwantowe
examples.why: 'teorioiformacyjna' is a typo for 'teorioinformacyjna' (dropped n) in the key definitional sentence of the process-fidelity section.

examples.source: standard linear operators for addition, subtraction, and scalar multiplication by complex numbers
examples.suggested: standardowych operacji liniowych: dodawania, odejmowania i mnożenia przez skalar (liczbę zespoloną)
examples.translation: standardowych operacji liniowych: dodawania, odejmowania i mnożenia skalarnego przez liczby zespolone
examples.why: In Polish 'mnożenie skalarne' is normally read as the scalar/dot product of two vectors, not multiplication of an operator by a scalar; 'mnożenie przez skalar' is the unambiguous term here.

editor_note: Semantically faithful throughout — I found no drift: the unbiased/biased contrast is preserved correctly on both sides ("não há garantia de que produza um resultado não viesado" for ZNE vs. "Ao contrário da ZNE, ele retorna uma estimativa não viesada" for PEC), the "could even worsen performance" caveat on dynamical decoupling survives intact, and quantities (fator de amplificação de 3, sobrecarga de ~3x, max_overhead 100) all match. Core terminology is correct and consistently applied: qubit, portas (gates), valores esperados, observáveis, backend/shots/job/Estimator kept in English, twirling kept in English with "twirling de Pauli"/"medições com twirling", "dobramento digital de portas" for digital gate folding, "entrelaçamento" for entangling (consistent in both occurrences). Informal "você" register holds everywhere ("você pode definir", "você pode habilitar"), no formal slips. What a native editor would still change is a small set of stiff calques: "é aprendido por benchmarking de circuitos aleatórios" (needs "por meio de"), "(3) inversão de bit clássico" (agreement lands on the wrong noun — should be "uma inversão clássica de bit"), "o desacoplamento dinâmico é principalmente útil para" (English adverb placement), and "distribuição de quasi-probabilidade" (Portuguese orthography is "quase-probabilidade"). None of these mislead — the page teaches as well as the English.

examples.source: A rescaling term from the diagonal noise channel is learned by benchmarking random circuits initialized in the zero state.
examples.suggested: ... é aprendido por meio do benchmarking de circuitos aleatórios inicializados no estado zero.
examples.translation: Um termo de reescalonamento do canal de ruído diagonal é aprendido por benchmarking de circuitos aleatórios inicializados no estado zero.
examples.why: "aprendido por benchmarking de" is a bare English-style instrumental; Portuguese needs "por meio de" (or "a partir do benchmarking de") before a nominalized borrowed noun. Grammatical but reads as MT.

examples.source: ... a sequence of (1) a Pauli X gate, (2) a measurement, and (3) classical bit flip.
examples.suggested: ... e (3) uma inversão clássica de bit.
examples.translation: ... uma sequência de (1) uma porta X de Pauli, (2) uma medição e (3) inversão de bit clássico.
examples.why: The adjective attaches to "bit" instead of to the flip, so it reads as "a flip of a classical bit" rather than "a classical bit-flip". Meaning is recoverable, but the agreement is misplaced and the missing article breaks the parallelism of the (1)/(2)/(3) list.

examples.source: ... so they form a quasi-probability distribution instead ... the negativity of the quasi-probability distribution
examples.suggested: distribuição de quase-probabilidade
examples.translation: ... portanto formam uma distribuição de quasi-probabilidade ... a negatividade da distribuição de quasi-probabilidade
examples.why: Portuguese physics writing uses the vernacular prefix "quase-" (quase-probabilidade, quase-partícula); "quasi-" is the Latin/English form. Recognizable, consistent within the file, so purely orthographic — but an editor would correct it. The dropped "instead" also flattens the contrast with the preceding probability-distribution case very slightly.

examples.source: dynamical decoupling is mainly useful for circuits containing gaps ... is executed multiple times at different noise rates
examples.suggested: é útil sobretudo para circuitos ... é executado várias vezes com diferentes taxas de ruído
examples.translation: o desacoplamento dinâmico é principalmente útil para circuitos que contêm lacunas ... é executado múltiplas vezes em diferentes taxas de ruído
examples.why: English adverb placement carried over: Portuguese puts "principalmente/sobretudo" after the predicate, not between copula and adjective. "múltiplas vezes" is a calque of "multiple times" where a native writer says "várias vezes". Stiff, not wrong.

editor_note: Nothing misleads: meaning is faithful throughout (statuses, `save_account()` trusted/untrusted branch, "apenas um job de function por vez", the two-form Function table), informal "você" holds, and "valores esperados"/"observáveis"/"mitigação de erros"/"transpilação" are consistent. What a native editor would change: (1) "unbiased expectation values" is rendered "valores esperados imparciais" (lines 55, twice) — "imparcial" is the everyday sense of unbiased; the statistical term in PT is "não enviesados"/"não tendenciosos"; (2) "quantum" is left as an English noun/adjective where PT has the word: "integrando o quantum em fluxos de trabalho" (38), "prontas para o quantum" (63), "otimização híbrida quantum-clássica" and "profundo conhecimento em quantum" (68) — should be "o quântico"/"a computação quântica", "quântico-clássica"; (3) "multi-physics PDEs" → "PDEs de múltipla física" (63) is a calque for the established "multifísica"; (4) "circuit transpilation" → "transpilação de Circuit" (206) leaves a capitalized English singular where the rest of the file uses "circuits"/"transpilação de circuitos".

examples.source: workflows that require unbiased expectation values and accurate runtime estimates … Produces unbiased expectation values with lower variance
examples.suggested: valores esperados não enviesados
examples.translation: fluxos de trabalho que exigem valores esperados imparciais e estimativas precisas de tempo de execução … Produz valores esperados imparciais com menor variância
examples.why: 'imparcial' carries the moral/judgmental sense of unbiased; the statistical estimator sense (bias vs. variance, contrasted here with ZNE/PEC) is 'não enviesado' / 'não tendencioso' in Portuguese technical usage. Recognizable but not the field's term.

examples.source: integrating quantum into existing large-scale classical workflows … build quantum-ready simulation capabilities … hybrid quantum-classical optimization … without deep quantum expertise
examples.suggested: integrando a computação quântica em … prontas para o quântico … otimização híbrida quântico-clássica … sem necessidade de profundo conhecimento em computação quântica
examples.translation: integrando o quantum em fluxos de trabalho clássicos … capacidades de simulação prontas para o quantum … otimização híbrida quantum-clássica … sem necessidade de profundo conhecimento em quantum
examples.why: 'quantum' is kept as a bare English noun/adjective four times where Portuguese has the ordinary word; 'quantum-clássica' in particular is a hybrid no PT technical writer would produce. Unlike 'Qiskit Functions' or 'shots', this is not a term the field keeps in English.

examples.source: Use quantum computation for multi-physics PDEs.
examples.suggested: PDEs multifísica (ou: PDEs de multifísica)
examples.translation: Use computação quântica para PDEs de múltipla física.
examples.why: 'de múltipla física' is a word-by-word calque; the established Portuguese engineering term for multi-physics simulation is 'multifísica'.

examples.source: This could include circuit transpilation, QPU characterization, observable backpropagation, and so forth
examples.suggested: transpilação de circuitos
examples.translation: Isso pode incluir transpilação de Circuit, caracterização do QPU, backpropagation de observáveis, entre outros
examples.why: Leaves a capitalized English singular 'Circuit' mid-sentence, inconsistent with the file's own lowercase 'circuits' elsewhere (lines 54–56); reads as a glossary-leak artifact rather than a deliberate keep-English choice.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inversions, swapped quantities or dropped caveats; the PNA explanation, the kicked-Ising setup and the max_err_terms/max_obs_terms monotonicity caveats all survive intact, and the informal "tu" holds ("Când rulezi PNA, va trebui întotdeauna să furnizezi..."). What a native editor would change is terminology consistency and calque: "entangling gates" appears both as "porți cu entanglare" (bullets under the boxing pass manager) and as the ungrammatical "porțile de intricate" (§Învață zgomotul, §Asociază boxurile) — "intricate" is left as an English adjective where Romanian needs "porți de întricare"; "box" splits three ways ("cutiile"/"cutia de măsurare" vs "boxurile de circuit"/"fiecare box" vs "circuitul boxat"); "twirl" splits between "răsucire" and untranslated "twirling" ("randomizări de twirling"); and "observabil" flips gender mid-file, masculine "observabilul măsurat" everywhere except §Transformarea bazelor, where it becomes feminine "observabila măsurată"/"observabila noastră originală". Glossary-driven mid-sentence capitals ("2 Qubiți", "Circuitul nostru", "îi furnizăm Backend-ul", "Eșantionarea Circuit-ului" with an un-Romanian hyphen) plus a few English calques ("Aceasta rezultă într-un observabil", "nu este garantat să fie monoton", "îmbrăcate în stânga", "pulsurile post-măsurătoare" for impulsuri) mark it as edited MT rather than native technical prose. None of this misleads a learner.

examples.source: the noise model affecting the entangling gates and measurements in the circuit
examples.suggested: ...care afectează porțile de întricare și măsurătorile din circuit
examples.translation: modelul de zgomot care afectează porțile de intricate și măsurătorile din circuit
examples.why: "porțile de intricate" is not grammatical Romanian — "intricate" is left as the English adjective where a noun is required. The same concept is rendered "porți cu entanglare" in the boxing-pass bullets, so entangling gates has two competing renderings, one of them broken.

examples.source: twirling randomizations / twirl layers of 2Q gates
examples.suggested: Pick one: either "twirling" throughout (with "randomizări de twirling") or "răsucire" throughout.
examples.translation: randomizare de răsucire ... Răsucirea straturilor de porți cu 2 Qubiți ... din randomizări de twirling
examples.why: The core technique of the section is named two different ways in the same file — a calqued "răsucire" in the outline and headings, the English "twirling" in the QuantumProgram bullet. A reader mapping the headings onto the parameter list has to guess they are the same operation.

examples.source: every Pauli term in the measured observable / our original observable
examples.suggested: observabilul măsurat ... observabilul nostru original
examples.translation: fiecare termen Pauli din observabila măsurată ... observabila noastră originală
examples.why: The file is consistently masculine ("observabilul măsurat", "propagăm observabilul", "un observabil mai complex") except this one section, which switches to the feminine "observabila". Gender flip on the file's central object reads as two translators merged.

examples.source: This results in a more complex observable which, when measured, has the effect of mitigating the learned gate noise.
examples.suggested: Astfel se obține un observabil mai complex care, măsurat, atenuează zgomotul de poartă învățat.
examples.translation: Aceasta rezultă într-un observabil mai complex care, atunci când este măsurat, are efectul de a atenua zgomotul de poartă învățat.
examples.why: "a rezulta în" is a direct calque of "to result in" and is flagged as an anglicism in Romanian usage; a native technical writer would use "astfel se obține" / "rezultatul este". Same pattern in the italic definition ("rezultând un observabil de reducere a zgomotului").

examples.source: Transpile it to the backend / affect our circuit / Sample the circuit / provide it the backend
examples.suggested: ...pentru backend ... circuitul nostru ... Eșantionarea circuitului ... îi furnizăm backendul
examples.translation: Îl transpilăm pentru Backend ... zgomotul ce va afecta Circuitul nostru ... Eșantionarea Circuit-ului ... îi furnizăm Backend-ul
examples.why: Common nouns are capitalized mid-sentence as if they were proper names (Backend, Circuit, Qubiți), and "Circuit-ul" takes a hyphen reserved for unassimilated foreign words. This is glossary-driven capitalization that no Romanian technical writer would produce; the surrounding text already uses lowercase "circuit" and "qubit" elsewhere in the same file.

examples.source: Allowing this to be larger generally increases accuracy, but this behavior is not guaranteed to be monotonic.
examples.suggested: Valorile mai mari cresc în general acuratețea, dar nu se garantează că acest comportament este monoton.
examples.translation: A permite un număr mai mare crește în general acuratețea, dar acest comportament nu este garantat să fie monoton.
examples.why: "nu este garantat să fie" copies the English passive-plus-infinitive; Romanian needs "nu se garantează că...". The bullet immediately below already uses the better construction ("nu este garantat că o fac monoton"), so the file is inconsistent with itself on the same caveat.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout and the informal "tu" register holds ("asigură-te", "autentifică-te", "să poți identifica"), but a native technical editor would rewrite several passages. The eigen- family is split four ways inside the same two paragraphs: English kept raw ("un eigenstate al unui operator unitar", "este un eigenvector al lui U(θ)", "eigenphase-ul"), a hybrid coinage ("Pregătim eigenstarea sa"), and proper Romanian ("valoarea proprie", "problemele de valori proprii", and once at the very end "faza proprie corectă" for the same eigenphase). Glossary-substitution artifacts leave ungrammatical or oddly capitalized forms mid-sentence: "poartă-ul de fază monoQubit" (feminine "poarta" given a masculine enclitic, plus camel-cased "monoQubit"), "Circuit-ul QPE" (should be "Circuitul", lowercase), "Backend-uri îmbunătățite"; "superpoziție" is misspelled as "superpozițe" in both places it occurs. Finally the closing paragraph loses precision: "zgomotul răspândește probabilitatea pe mulți biți incorecți" drops "șiruri de" (bitstrings → bits, the wrong object), and "distribuția devine mai clară" flattens "the distribution becomes sharper" (peaked/concentrated, not merely clearer).

examples.source: QPE estimates the phase φ associated with an eigenstate of a unitary operator … |1⟩ is an eigenvector of U(θ) with eigenvalue e^{iθ}, the eigenphase to be estimated is … The simulation sets the baseline for the correct eigenphase.
examples.suggested: stare proprie / vector propriu / valoare proprie / fază proprie — used consistently (e.g. "faza proprie asociată unei stări proprii a unui operator unitar", "|1⟩ este vector propriu al lui U(θ) cu valoarea proprie e^{iθ}")
examples.translation: faza φ asociată cu un eigenstate al unui operator unitar … Pregătim eigenstarea sa … este un eigenvector al lui U(θ) cu valoarea proprie … eigenphase-ul care trebuie estimat … linia de referință pentru faza proprie corectă
examples.why: The same concept family is rendered as raw English, as a Romanian–English hybrid ("eigenstarea"), and as correct Romanian, sometimes within one sentence; the final paragraph's "faza proprie" is never linked back to the "eigenphase-ul" used everywhere above.

examples.source: we illustrate QPE to recover the eigenphase of a known single-qubit unitary. The unitary whose phase we want to estimate is the single-qubit phase gate applied to the target qubit
examples.suggested: ilustrăm QPE pentru a recupera faza proprie a unui operator unitar cunoscut pe un singur qubit. Operatorul unitar a cărui fază vrem să o estimăm este poarta de fază pe un singur qubit, aplicată qubitului țintă
examples.translation: ilustrăm QPE pentru a recupera eigenphase-ul unui unitar monoQubit cunoscut. Unitarul a cărui fază vrem să o estimăm este poartă-ul de fază monoQubit aplicat qubitului țintă
examples.why: "poartă-ul" attaches a masculine enclitic article to the feminine noun "poartă" — plainly ungrammatical — and "monoQubit" is a camel-cased coinage no Romanian technical writer would produce; "un unitar" as a bare noun also reads as a glossary substitution rather than Romanian.

examples.source: Default hardware runs show noise that obscures this result, as noise spreads probability across many incorrect bitstrings. With Q-CTRL Performance Management the distribution becomes sharper
examples.suggested: …deoarece zgomotul distribuie probabilitatea pe multe șiruri de biți incorecte. Cu Q-CTRL Performance Management, distribuția devine mai îngustă (mai concentrată)
examples.translation: Rulările pe hardware implicit arată zgomot care maschează acest rezultat, deoarece zgomotul răspândește probabilitatea pe mulți biți incorecți. Cu Q-CTRL Performance Management, distribuția devine mai clară
examples.why: "biți incorecți" changes the object from measurement outcomes (bitstrings, correctly "șiruri de biți" everywhere else in the file) to individual bits; "mai clară" (clearer) loses the quantitative point that the peak becomes narrower/more concentrated.

examples.source: By preparing these qubits in superposition … the large number of qubits and entangling operations
examples.suggested: Prin pregătirea acestor qubiți în superpoziție … numărul mare de qubiți și de operații de întricare
examples.translation: Prin pregătirea acestor qubiți în superpozițe … numărul mare de qubiți și operații de entanglament
examples.why: "superpozițe" is a misspelling of "superpoziție" and occurs in both places the word appears; "entanglament" is an ad-hoc calque where Romanian technical usage is "întricare" (or the English term kept intact).

examples.source: resulting in higher-fidelity outcomes … Fire Opal–enhanced backends
examples.suggested: ceea ce duce la rezultate cu fidelitate mai mare … backend-uri îmbunătățite cu Fire Opal
examples.translation: rezultând în rezultate de fidelitate mai ridicată … Backend-uri îmbunătățite cu Fire Opal
examples.why: "rezultând în rezultate" is a doubled calque of "resulting in results" that a native editor would never leave; "Backend-uri" (and "Circuit-ul QPE" at lines 86/126/174) carry mid-sentence capitalization inherited from the glossary rather than from Romanian orthography.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every number, boundary condition, and symbol gloss in the CFD/MD sections matches the English (t 0–0.95 / 30 จุดตัวอย่าง / step 0.2375, x 0–1 step 0.04, and the ε₀/σ₀/u/σ list is copied exactly as the source states it), and terminology is kept-in-English consistently (qubits, observable, ansatz, shots, gradient, optimizer, loss function) with no ครับ/ค่ะ slips. What a native editor would change is the residual translationese in the Overview: "$2^n$ ของพวกมัน" is a word-for-word calque of "2^n of them" where Thai wants a classifier construction (จำนวน $2^n$ ตัว); "observable ที่การผสมผสานช่วยให้ประเมินฟังก์ชันที่ทุกจุดได้" reproduces the English "whose combinations" relative clause in a shape Thai technical prose does not use; and "ปล่อยให้ระบบผ่อนคลาย" renders the physics sense of "relax" with the everyday unwind/de-stress word instead of คลายตัว/เข้าสู่สภาวะสมดุล. There is also a small within-file split on "hybrid loop": "การวนซ้ำแบบ hybrid" in ¶2 vs. the bare English "hybrid loop" in ¶3. None of these mislead — the concepts stay identifiable — so this is polish, not a correctness problem.

examples.source: typically Chebyshev polynomials, and more specifically $2^n$ of them where $n$ is the number of qubits encoding your function
examples.suggested: โดยทั่วไปคือพหุนาม Chebyshev โดยเฉพาะจำนวน $2^n$ ตัว เมื่อ $n$ คือจำนวน qubits ที่ encode ฟังก์ชันของคุณ
examples.translation: โดยทั่วไปคือพหุนาม Chebyshev และโดยเฉพาะ $2^n$ ของพวกมัน โดยที่ $n$ คือจำนวน qubits ที่ encode ฟังก์ชันของคุณ
examples.why: "$2^n$ ของพวกมัน" is a literal calque of English "2^n of them"; Thai counts with a classifier (…จำนวน $2^n$ ตัว) and a native writer would never use ของพวกมัน for a partitive of a math object.

examples.source: The ansatz generates a state encoding the function, which is evaluated by observables whose combinations allow for evaluating the function at all points.
examples.suggested: ansatz สร้าง state ที่ encode ฟังก์ชันไว้ แล้ววัดค่าด้วย observable หลายตัว ซึ่งเมื่อนำผลมารวมกันจะได้ค่าของฟังก์ชันที่ทุกจุด
examples.translation: ansatz สร้าง state ที่ encode ฟังก์ชัน ซึ่งถูกประเมินโดย observable ที่การผสมผสานช่วยให้ประเมินฟังก์ชันที่ทุกจุดได้
examples.why: The English "whose combinations" relative clause is mapped one-to-one onto Thai (observable ที่การผสมผสานช่วยให้…), producing a stiff, hard-to-parse chain; Thai prefers splitting into a sequential clause. Meaning survives, but it reads as MT rather than as written Thai.

examples.source: you can select the initial condition and then allow the system to relax
examples.suggested: คุณเลือกเงื่อนไขเริ่มต้นแล้วปล่อยให้ระบบคลายตัวเข้าสู่สมดุล
examples.translation: คุณเลือกเงื่อนไขเริ่มต้นและปล่อยให้ระบบผ่อนคลาย
examples.why: "ผ่อนคลาย" is the everyday "relax/unwind" sense; the physics sense of relaxation toward equilibrium is คลายตัว / เข้าสู่สภาวะสมดุล. Recognizable from context, so MINOR, but it is the wrong register of the term.

examples.source: fine-tune the angles in a hybrid loop … In addition to this hybrid loop
examples.suggested: pick one rendering — either การวนซ้ำแบบ hybrid in both places, or hybrid loop in both
examples.translation: ปรับแต่งมุมในการวนซ้ำแบบ hybrid … นอกจาก hybrid loop นี้
examples.why: The same concept, referred to anaphorically across two adjacent paragraphs ("this hybrid loop" points back to the loop just described), is rendered two different ways, so the back-reference is weaker than in the English.

editor_note: No misleading content: the feature table is byte-identical to EN and all nine notes carry the right polarity (🟡/❌ semantics, "not eligible for execution on hardware" → "ไม่รองรับสำหรับการรันบนฮาร์ดแวร์", the July-2025 / v0.6.0 caveats all survive). Four things a native technical editor would still fix. (1) The "Next steps" list has a leaked untranslated source line — "- Review the [Verify your program](/guides/debugging-tools) topic." sits directly above its own Thai rendering "อ่าน [Verify your program]", so that bullet is duplicated and half-English, and its indentation breaks the list. (2) "represent / representation" is rendered as แสดง / แสดงผล ("display, render output") in the Qiskit SDK column and in note 4 — แสดงผลใน `QuantumCircuit` reads as "rendered/displayed in a QuantumCircuit" rather than "representable as"; แทน / แสดงแทน is the right verb, and แสดงผล is specifically the wrong one because it collides with the neighbouring output/export sense. (3) "resolve" is rendered แก้ไข ("fix, correct, edit") in note 5 — "parser สามารถแก้ไข `let` alias statement" says the parser edits the statement rather than resolving the alias. (4) Two qualifiers dropped: "the complete 'supported' mark" loses แบบเต็ม (the contrast with รองรับบางส่วน is what that sentence exists to set up), and note 1's "backend execution *always* requires" loses เสมอ. Register convention holds throughout — casual, no ครับ/ค่ะ, and the keep-English convention (parse, export, circuit, backend, transpile, declaration, expression, hardware qubit) is applied consistently.

examples.source: - Review the [Verify your program](/guides/debugging-tools) topic.
examples.suggested: - อ่านหัวข้อ [Verify your program](/guides/debugging-tools)
examples.translation:
- Review the [Verify your program](/guides/debugging-tools) topic.
    - อ่าน [Verify your program](/guides/debugging-tools)
examples.why: Untranslated source bullet left in place alongside its Thai rendering, so the recommendation appears twice — once in English, once in Thai — and the stray line is indented differently from the other four items, breaking the list. Delete the English line and keep only the Thai one.

examples.source: represented in a `QuantumCircuit` … features that are supported for representation in Qiskit SDK … can represent local variables of a restricted set of types
examples.suggested: แทนได้ด้วย [`QuantumCircuit`] … ฟีเจอร์ที่รองรับการแสดงแทนใน Qiskit SDK … สามารถแสดงแทนตัวแปรท้องถิ่นของชุดประเภทที่จำกัด
examples.translation: แสดงผลใน [`QuantumCircuit`] … ฟีเจอร์ที่รองรับสำหรับการแสดงผลใน Qiskit SDK … สามารถแสดงตัวแปรท้องถิ่นของชุดประเภทที่จำกัด
examples.why: แสดงผล means "display / render output" — in a sentence that also talks about export เป็น OpenQASM 3 it reads as an output step rather than as the SDK's internal representation of the feature. แทน / แสดงแทน is the conventional Thai rendering of "represent" in this sense.

examples.source: The Qiskit OpenQASM 3 parser can resolve `let` alias statements that bind the result of register concantenation.
examples.suggested: Qiskit OpenQASM 3 parser สามารถ resolve (ตีความ) `let` alias statement ที่ผูกผลลัพธ์ของ register concatenation ได้
examples.translation: Qiskit OpenQASM 3 parser สามารถแก้ไข `let` alias statement ที่ผูกผลลัพธ์ของ register concatenation ได้
examples.why: แก้ไข means "fix / correct / edit", so the sentence says the parser modifies the user's `let` statement rather than resolving the alias to what it refers to. Recognizable in context but the wrong verb for parser "resolve".

examples.source: The meaning of the complete "supported" mark depends on the column. … backend execution always requires circuits to have been compiled to the backend ISA
examples.suggested: ความหมายของเครื่องหมาย "รองรับ" แบบเต็มจะขึ้นอยู่กับคอลัมน์ … และการรันบน backend ต้องการ circuit ที่ compile ไปยัง backend ISA แล้วเสมอ
examples.translation: ความหมายของเครื่องหมาย "รองรับ" จะขึ้นอยู่กับคอลัมน์ … และการรันบน backend ต้องการ circuit ที่ compile ไปยัง backend ISA แล้ว
examples.why: Two qualifiers dropped. "complete" is what sets up the contrast with the following paragraph on รองรับบางส่วน, and "always" is the strength of the ISA requirement — without เสมอ it reads as a general expectation rather than an unconditional one.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, swapped quantities, or dropped caveats; the CHSH bounds (±2 classical, ±2√2 Tsirelson), the "63/64 pairs violated" framing, and the local-hidden-variable argument all survive intact, and the register stays casual (tayo/natin, no po/opo). What a native technical editor would change is a cluster of calques and one broken rendering: "qualitatively similar" becomes "kalidad na katulad" (reads as "similar in quality", and the syntax "ang tugon ng simulator ay kalidad na katulad ng" is ungrammatical); "intrinsically a two-qubit experiment" becomes "mahalagang isang two-qubit na eksperimento" (mahalaga = important, not likas/intrinsic); "in part for their pioneering work" becomes the word-for-word "dahil, sa bahagi, sa"; "in terms of A, a, B, b" becomes the false-friend "sa mga termino ng"; and "If you found this work interesting" becomes "Kung nahanap mong kawili-wili" (nahanap = located). Terminology is otherwise correct and consistent (qubit, entanglement, expectation values, observable, backend, transpile, parameter sweep, PUB all kept in English as the field does), except that "circuit" is arbitrarily capitalized as "Circuit" in four places (lines 19, 122, 258, 385) while lowercase elsewhere, and both "Prerequisites" and "Requirements" are rendered as the identical heading "Mga kinakailangan".

examples.source: so the simulator response is qualitatively similar to what we expect from hardware
examples.suggested: kaya ang tugon ng simulator ay katulad sa katangian ng inaasahan natin mula sa hardware
examples.translation: kaya ang tugon ng simulator ay kalidad na katulad ng inaasahan natin mula sa hardware
examples.why: "Qualitatively" is rendered as "kalidad" (quality/grade), shifting the claim from "similar in character/behavior" to "similar in quality"; the resulting phrase "ay kalidad na katulad ng" is also not grammatical Tagalog.

examples.source: A CHSH test is intrinsically a *two-qubit* experiment
examples.suggested: Ang CHSH test ay likas na isang *two-qubit* na eksperimento
examples.translation: Ang CHSH test ay mahalagang isang *two-qubit* na eksperimento
examples.why: "Mahalaga" means important/significant, not intrinsic/inherent, so the sentence reads "importantly a two-qubit experiment" and loses the reason the experiment cannot scale by enlarging one circuit.

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material
examples.suggested: Kung naging kawili-wili sa iyo ang gawaing ito, baka interesado ka rin sa mga sumusunod
examples.translation: Kung nahanap mong kawili-wili ang gawaing ito, maaari kang maging interesado sa sumusunod na materyal
examples.why: "Nahanap" is the locate sense of "found"; a native writer would never say "nahanap mong kawili-wili". Classic word-for-word calque.

examples.source: was awarded to Alain Aspect, John Clauser, and Anton Zeilinger in part for their pioneering work
examples.suggested: ay iginawad kina ... dahil na rin sa kanilang pioneering work
examples.translation: ay iginawad kina Alain Aspect, John Clauser, at Anton Zeilinger dahil, sa bahagi, sa kanilang pioneering work
examples.why: "Dahil, sa bahagi, sa" is a literal transposition of "in part for"; Tagalog uses "dahil na rin sa" or "bahagyang dahil sa". Same paragraph also has "pinangalanan mula kina" for "named after" (line 32), where "ipinangalan kina" is idiomatic.

examples.source: circuit / parameterized circuit / one circuit bigger
examples.suggested: Use lowercase "circuit" consistently throughout
examples.translation: CHSH Circuit ... mas malaking Circuit (capitalized) vs. parameterized circuit, transpiled circuit (lowercase)
examples.why: The same English loanword is capitalized as a proper noun in four places and lowercase in the rest of the file — within-file inconsistency an editor would unify; also "Mga kinakailangan" is reused verbatim for both the Prerequisites and the Requirements headings.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, swapped quantities, or dropped caveats — and the register is correctly casual (no po/opo); domain terms are sensibly kept in English (qubit, gate, circuit, transpiler, backend, shot, observable, expectation value, Sampler/Estimator, error suppression/mitigation) and used consistently. What a native technical editor would still change: (a) "measurement" splits within the file — "network ng mga quantum gate at sukatan" (para. on circuit anatomy) uses "sukatan", which this same file already uses for "performance metrics" ("tatlong sukatan ng performance"), while the very next paragraph correctly uses "pagsukat"; (b) English discourse adverbs are left untranslated and even double-marked — "Ang hakbang na Map ay essentially ay nagtatanong" (ungrammatical double "ay"), plus "Essentially, sinasangkot nito…" and "Specifically, kinakalkula nito…"; (c) several stiff calques/agrammatical spots — "sa qubit na ang wire ay nakalagay ito", "Ito ay nagpapaliwanag sa sarili" for "self-explanatory", "circuit na iginagalang ang heavy-hex topology" for "respects", "saan maaari" for "wherever possible", and the typo "marikilala" for "makikilala". None of these would mislead a learner; they are fluency/consistency fixes.

examples.source: A quantum circuit is a network of quantum gates and measurements linked by wires…
examples.suggested: …network ng mga quantum gate at pagsukat na pinag-uugnay ng mga wire…
examples.translation: Ang isang quantum circuit ay isang network ng mga quantum gate at sukatan na naka-link ng mga wire…
examples.why: "Sukatan" means metric/measure — and this file already uses it for the performance metrics ("tatlong sukatan ng performance"). The next paragraph correctly renders measurement as "pagsukat" ("simbolo ng pagsukat", "mga resulta ng mga pagsukat"), so the term is split within the file.

examples.source: The Map step essentially asks the question: …
examples.suggested: Ang hakbang na Map ay talagang nagtatanong ng: …
examples.translation: Ang hakbang na Map ay essentially ay nagtatanong: …
examples.why: Ungrammatical double "ay" around an untranslated English adverb. The same leak occurs elsewhere: "Essentially, sinasangkot nito…" (Post-process) and "Specifically, kinakalkula nito…" (Sampler).

examples.source: Single-qubit gates … affect only the qubit whose wire it's placed on.
examples.suggested: … ay nakakaapekto lamang sa qubit kung saang wire ito nakalagay.
examples.translation: Ang mga single-qubit gate … ay nakakaapekto lamang sa qubit na ang wire ay nakalagay ito.
examples.why: The relative clause is broken Tagalog — a native technical writer would not write "sa qubit na ang wire ay nakalagay ito"; the reader has to reconstruct the intended relation.

examples.source: This is self-explanatory: it's the number of total qubits available…
examples.suggested: Halata na ito sa sarili nito: ito ang kabuuang bilang ng mga qubit na magagamit…
examples.translation: Ito ay nagpapaliwanag sa sarili: ito ang kabuuang bilang ng mga qubit na magagamit…
examples.why: Word-for-word calque of "self-explanatory"; "nagpapaliwanag sa sarili" reads as "explains itself to itself" rather than idiomatic Tagalog. Same paragraph also has the Taglish "para matackle ang problema" where "para malutas/harapin" is natural.

examples.source: …which experienced Qiskit users will likely recognize. / …a circuit that respects IBM quantum processors' heavy-hex topology. / …eliminate long-distance interactions wherever possible.
examples.suggested: …na malamang ay makikilala… / …circuit na sumusunod sa heavy-hex topology… / …hangga't maaari / kung saan maaari.
examples.translation: …na malamang ay marikilala ng mga bihasang gumagamit ng Qiskit. / …circuit na iginagalang ang heavy-hex topology… / …alisin ang mga long-distance na interaksyon saan maaari.
examples.why: One typo ("marikilala"), one literal calque ("iginagalang" for "respects" a topology — the field says "sumusunod sa"), and one clipped adverbial ("saan maaari"). All recognizable, none misleading, but each is a fix a native editor would make.

editor_note: One answer block garbles the module's central physics: EN "would experience a single inhomogeneous field" became "відчуватимуть однорідне неоднорідне поле" — literally "a homogeneous inhomogeneous field", where "single" was rendered as "однорідне" (homogeneous). That is a self-contradictory claim about the very field whose inhomogeneity the whole Stern-Gerlach setup depends on, sitting in a "Перевір своє розуміння" answer a learner reads as authoritative. Second, in "Задачі у вільній формі" problem 2 the target state label was swapped: EN asks to show $|-\rangle_x = \frac{1}{\sqrt2}(1,-1)$, the uk file asks to show $|+\rangle_x = \frac{1}{\sqrt2}(1,-1)$ — which directly contradicts problem 1 on the same page and is simply false. Beyond those, the "Ключові концепції" bullets abandon the file's own established "кубіт" and print the English "Qubit" three times ("Qubit можна виміряти", "використовуючи Qubit", "частинки/Qubit"), and there are agreement/register slips elsewhere ("одне зі «дозволених значень»", "один із двох крайніх значень", "не соромся грати з іншими значеннями"). Register is otherwise consistently informal "ти" throughout.

examples.source: The particles in the center of the device would experience a single inhomogeneous field and would all be measured to have one of two orientations to their magnetic moments.
examples.suggested: Частинки в центрі пристрою потрапляють в одне й те саме неоднорідне поле, і всі вони будуть виміряні як такі, що мають одну з двох орієнтацій магнітного моменту.
examples.translation: Частинки в центрі пристрою відчуватимуть однорідне неоднорідне поле і всі будуть виміряні як такі, що мають одну з двох орієнтацій магнітного моменту.
examples.why: "single" was rendered as "однорідне" (homogeneous), producing the contradiction "однорідне неоднорідне поле". The inhomogeneity of the field is the load-bearing fact of the entire Stern-Gerlach module; a learner is told the field is simultaneously homogeneous and inhomogeneous.

examples.source: show that up to a global phase $$|-\rangle_x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\begin{pmatrix}1 \\ -1\end{pmatrix}$$
examples.suggested: покажи, що з точністю до глобальної фази $$|-\rangle_x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\begin{pmatrix}1 \\ -1\end{pmatrix}$$
examples.translation: покажи, що з точністю до глобальної фази $$|+\rangle_x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\begin{pmatrix}1 \\ -1\end{pmatrix}$$
examples.why: The ket label was flipped from |−⟩_x to |+⟩_x, so the exercise now asks the learner to prove a false identity that also contradicts problem 1 immediately above (|+⟩_x = (1, e^{iα})/√2 with α=0, i.e. (1,1)/√2).

examples.source: Qubits can only be measured in one of two states … using qubits in a quantum computer … of the same particle/qubit
examples.suggested: Кубіт можна виміряти лише в одному з двох станів … використовуючи кубіти у квантовому комп'ютері … однієї й тієї самої частинки/кубіта
examples.translation: Qubit можна виміряти лише в одному з двох станів … використовуючи Qubit у квантовому комп'ютері … однієї й тієї самої частинки/Qubit
examples.why: The rest of the file consistently and correctly uses «кубіт»/«кубіти» (e.g. «Більшість квантових комп'ютерів використовує «кубіти»»). The summary section drops to an untranslated, capitalised English "Qubit", also uninflected, breaking both consistency and Ukrainian case agreement in the final recap the learner reviews.

examples.source: After all, if a qubit is measured to be in one state, and then I measure it again, quickly, why wouldn't it still be in that state?
examples.suggested: Зрештою, якщо кубіт виміряли в певному стані, а я одразу виміряю його знову — чому б він раптом опинився в іншому стані?
examples.translation: Зрештою, якщо кубіт виміряли в одному стані, і я знову виміряю його відразу ж, чому б він перебував у іншому стані?
examples.why: The rhetorical question was re-cast with an inverted polarity and no particle to carry it («чому б він перебував»), so it reads as ungrammatical translationese rather than the English's casual "why wouldn't it still be…".

examples.source: feel free to play with other values / one of a set of "allowed values" / a roughly 50-50 chance of measuring one extremum
examples.suggested: можеш поекспериментувати з іншими значеннями / дає лише одне з набору «дозволених значень» / ймовірність виміряти одне з двох крайніх значень
examples.translation: не соромся грати з іншими значеннями / дає лише одне зі «дозволених значень» / ймовірність виміряти один із двох крайніх значень
examples.why: «не соромся грати» is a literal calque of "feel free to play" no Ukrainian technical writer would use; «зі «дозволених»» uses the wrong preposition form and drops "a set of"; «один із двох крайніх значень» mismatches gender/number with the neuter «значень».

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no inverted conditions, no dropped caveats (the removal note correctly keeps both halves: "стають для нього невидимими" / "Інші користувачі того самого екземпляра надалі можуть отримувати доступ"), and the informal "ти" convention holds consistently across every imperative (створи, переконайся, вибери, натисни, введи, признач, перейди). Three things a native technical editor would still change. (1) "overflow menu" is calqued as "меню переповнення", which in Ukrainian reads as "overflow" in the buffer/spill sense rather than the three-dot UI menu; "меню додаткових дій" is the idiomatic rendering. (2) Step 5 breaks number agreement by carrying English singular "they" over literally: "Користувач отримає запрошення… Після прийняття запрошення вони побачать" — Ukrainian requires "він побачить" / "користувач побачить". (3) "Створи екземпляри свого облікового запису до того, як запрошувати користувачів" is a stiff construction; "перш ніж запрошувати користувачів" is what a native writer would put. None of these would lead a learner to a false belief.

examples.source: Click the overflow menu at the end of the user's row
examples.suggested: Натисни меню додаткових дій у кінці рядка користувача
examples.translation: Натисни меню переповнення в кінці рядка користувача
examples.why: "меню переповнення" is a word-for-word calque; in Ukrainian "переповнення" means buffer/container overflow, not the Carbon three-dot action menu. Used consistently, so recognizable in context, but not the conventional UI term.

examples.source: The user will receive an invitation … After they accept the invitation, they will see a new account in their account switcher
examples.suggested: … Після прийняття запрошення він побачить новий обліковий запис у своєму перемикачі облікових записів
examples.translation: Користувач отримає запрошення … Після прийняття запрошення вони побачать новий обліковий запис у перемикачі облікових записів
examples.why: English singular "they" is carried over as plural "вони" after singular "користувач", producing a number-agreement break Ukrainian does not tolerate — a clear MT fingerprint.

examples.source: Create your account's instances before you invite users.
examples.suggested: Створи екземпляри свого облікового запису, перш ніж запрошувати користувачів.
examples.translation: Створи екземпляри свого облікового запису до того, як запрошувати користувачів.
examples.why: "до того, як" does not idiomatically govern a bare infinitive; the natural conjunction here is "перш ніж". Grammatically borderline and stiff rather than wrong.

editor_note: Faithful and idiomatic; the load-bearing overwrite caveat survives intact ("يقوم هذا التابع بالكتابة فوق الوسوم الحالية... احرص على إعادة تعيين الوسوم الأصلية"), and terms are correct and consistent (tag→وسم, job→وظيفة, method→التابع, error mitigation→تخفيف الأخطاء, circuit parameters→معاملات الدائرة) with uniform informal singular register.

Nothing here would mislead a learner: every migration instruction, removal list and API-name reference is faithful, the informal singular register (استخدم/يمكنك/كنت) holds throughout, and the term conventions are consistent (transpiler→المترجم / transpilation→الترجمة (transpilation), Target/backend/qubit/context manager kept in Latin, fractional gates→البوابات الكسرية, pulse-level access→وصول على مستوى النبضة). What a native technical editor would still change: (a) "loose constraint inputs" is rendered "مدخلات القيود المنفصلة" ("separate/discrete constraints") — recognizable but the wrong sense; "فضفاضة"/"المنفردة" is the right register; (b) a gender-agreement slip, "لا يوفر خريطة الاقتران" for feminine خريطة (should be لا توفر), and similarly "هذه الخاصيتان لم تعودا" instead of "لم تعد هاتان الخاصيتان"; (c) two dropped/altered qualifiers — "The most direct translation" becomes "أبسط ترجمة" (simplest), and "will typically cause Instruction instances to behave…" loses "typically" (عادةً); (d) calques a native writer would rework: "بشكل تفضيلي" for "preferentially", "توصيلاً أكثر تعبيراً" for "a more expressive communication", "الكتلة البادئة" for "indented block" (reads as "the leading block"; المسافة البادئة is the idiom), and the tangled relative clause "فالافتراضات التي تُعدّ صالحة في ظلها ستنتهك" which inverts what is valid under what. None of these changes the technical instruction.

examples.source: handling of loose constraint inputs, such as `coupling_map` or `basis_gates`
examples.suggested: معالجة مدخلات القيود الفضفاضة (loose constraints)، مثل `coupling_map` أو `basis_gates`
examples.translation: معالجة مدخلات القيود المنفصلة، مثل `coupling_map` أو `basis_gates`
examples.why: "منفصلة" means separate/discrete; the transpiler sense of "loose" is unstructured constraints passed outside a Target. Recognizable, so MINOR, but it is the wrong sense and it is repeated in the same paragraph.

examples.source: The coupling map does not provide the necessary connectivity details to be able to determine the action of the gate.
examples.suggested: لا توفر خريطة الاقتران (coupling map) تفاصيل الاتصال الضرورية لتحديد فعل البوابة.
examples.translation: لا يوفر خريطة الاقتران (coupling map) تفاصيل الاتصال الضرورية لتحديد سلوك البوابة.
examples.why: Gender-agreement error: خريطة is feminine and requires لا توفر. A native technical writer would not leave this; same class of slip as "هذه الخاصيتان لم تعودا" (should be لم تعد هاتان الخاصيتان) at AR 99.

examples.source: The most direct translation of this is to use the 2-tuple form with the `if_test` context manager
examples.suggested: أقرب ترجمة مباشرة لهذا هي استخدام شكل الزوج الثنائي مع الـ context manager `if_test`
examples.translation: أبسط ترجمة لهذا هي استخدام شكل الزوج الثنائي مع الـ context manager `if_test`
examples.why: "most direct" (closest one-to-one port of the old code) is softened into "simplest", a different claim — the section goes on to show that the richer expr form is also available. Does not mislead about the API, so MINOR.

examples.source: you can use `getattr(operation, "condition", None)`, which will typically cause `Instruction` instances to behave as they did in Qiskit v1.x and earlier
examples.suggested: … وهذا سيجعل كائنات `Instruction` تتصرف عادةً كما كانت في Qiskit v1.x والإصدارات الأقدم
examples.translation: يمكنك استخدام `getattr(operation, "condition", None)`، وهذا سيجعل كائنات `Instruction` تتصرف كما كانت في Qiskit v1.x والإصدارات الأقدم
examples.why: The hedge "typically" is dropped, turning a qualified compatibility shim into an unconditional promise. Small enough not to mislead about the recommended path, but the caveat is deliberate in the English.

examples.source: you can also have the conditional gate access to multiple operations (simply add more into the indented block) without re-evaluating the conditions
examples.suggested: … (يكفي أن تضيف المزيد داخل الكتلة المُزاحة) دون إعادة تقييم الشروط
examples.translation: يمكنك أيضاً أن تجعل البوابة المشروطة تنفّذ عمليات متعددة (أضف المزيد منها في الكتلة البادئة) دون إعادة تقييم الشروط
examples.why: "الكتلة البادئة" reads as "the leading/initial block", not "the indented block"; the Arabic idiom for indentation is المسافة البادئة / مُزاح. Pedagogically the pointer to the with-block body is blurred.

examples.source: it is recommended to move away from it, as it will likely be removed in the future; the assumptions under which it is valid will be violated more and more frequently
examples.suggested: … ؛ إذ ستُنتهَك على نحو متزايد الافتراضاتُ التي لا تكون صالحةً إلا في ظلها
examples.translation: يُنصح بالابتعاد عنها، إذ من المرجح أن تُزال في المستقبل؛ فالافتراضات التي تُعدّ صالحة في ظلها ستنتهك بشكل متزايد
examples.why: The relative clause inverts the dependency: the Arabic says the assumptions are considered valid under the attribute, whereas the English says the attribute is valid only under those assumptions. The takeaway (stop using it) survives, so MINOR, but the reasoning is muddied.

editor_note: The prose is broadly accurate and correctly informal ("zjistíš", "najdeš"), and numbers/dates/qubit counts all match the English. The main defect is the handling of "gate": it is left untranslated and mis-declined as a pseudo-Czech word throughout the tip block and Heron section ("Nativní Gates a operace", "jednoqubitových Gate", "věrnost Gate") instead of the established Czech term "hradlo/hradla" — recognizable, but not something a Czech technical writer would write; the same passage also carries the typo "dvoququbitových" (triple q) for "dvouqubitových". Two smaller meaning shifts: "controls the TLS environment" became "kontroluje prostředí TLS" (Czech "kontrolovat" = to check/inspect, not to control/řídit), and the tip's title/body were rendered as "Nativní Gates a operace" rather than the English "Supported instruction set / supported instructions". Finally, two calques read as MT: "technologickém zásobníku" for "technology stack" (Czech IT keeps "stack") and "Jak jsou přidávány nové rodiny procesorů, starší rodiny jsou vyřazovány" for the English "As … are added" construction.

examples.source: the supported instruction set … two-qubit and single-qubit control … gate fidelity
examples.suggested: Nativní hradla a operace … jednoqubitových hradel … věrnost hradel
examples.translation: Nativní Gates a operace … jednoqubitových Gate … věrnost Gate
examples.why: "Gate" is left in English and inflected as if it were Czech ("Gates" as a Czech plural, "věrnost Gate" with no case ending). The conventional Czech domain term is "hradlo" (pl. "hradla"); the current rendering is recognizable but reads as a glossary leak, and it is used inconsistently with the otherwise fully Czech surrounding prose.

examples.source: the fast, high-fidelity two-qubit and single-qubit control
examples.suggested: rychlé a vysoce věrné ovládání dvouqubitových a jednoqubitových hradel
examples.translation: rychlé a vysoce věrné ovládání dvoququbitových a jednoqubitových Gate
examples.why: "dvoququbitových" contains a typo (three q's); the correct form is "dvouqubitových".

examples.source: a new TLS mitigation feature that controls the TLS environment of the chip
examples.suggested: …která řídí (ovládá) prostředí TLS čipu
examples.translation: novou funkci pro zmírnění TLS, která kontroluje prostředí TLS čipu
examples.why: Classic false friend: Czech "kontrolovat" means to check/inspect, not to control. As written the feature merely monitors the TLS environment, whereas the English says it actively governs it — which is what makes the coherence/stability improvement follow.

examples.source: Supported instruction set — To find the supported instruction set for a backend … You can see all supported instructions in this table.
examples.suggested: Podporovaná instrukční sada — Podporovanou instrukční sadu backendu zjistíš … Všechny podporované instrukce najdeš v této tabulce.
examples.translation: Nativní Gates a operace — Nativní Gates a operace backendu zjistíš … Všechny nativní Gates a operace najdeš v této tabulce.
examples.why: The admonition title and both sentences say "native gates and operations" where the current English says "supported instruction set" / "supported instructions". The links point to the same anchors so it is not misleading, but the wording no longer tracks the source.

examples.source: Nighthawk leverages our technology stack from Heron (couplers, signal delivery, and coherence)
examples.suggested: staví na technologickém stacku z Heronu / na technologiích převzatých z Heronu
examples.translation: staví na našem technologickém zásobníku z Heronu (couplery, přívod signálů a koherence)
examples.why: "Zásobník" is the literal word for a stack (data structure, magazine) and is not what Czech engineers say for a technology stack; the calque makes the sentence read as machine output.

examples.source: As new processor families are added, older families are retired.
examples.suggested: S tím, jak přibývají nové rodiny procesorů, se ty starší vyřazují.
examples.translation: Jak jsou přidávány nové rodiny procesorů, starší rodiny jsou vyřazovány.
examples.why: Direct calque of the English "As … are added" clause plus a double passive; a native technical writer would use "S tím, jak…" and an active/reflexive verb.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, dropped caveats or swapped numbers — and the finance/optimization core ("účelová funkce", "Sharpeho poměr", "rozlišovací qubity", "ansatz") is correct and consistent, so nothing here misleads a learner. What a Czech editor would change: the English word "Circuit" is left untranslated and undeclined three times ("počtem qubitů v Circuit", "více spuštění Circuit", "rozlišovacích Qubitů, Circuit ansatzů"), which is ungrammatical Czech and should be "obvod/obvodů"; the same sentence also capitalizes "Qubitů" against the lowercase "qubitů" used everywhere else. "Baseline" is rendered as "výchozí stav" ("náhodným výchozím stavem", "zašuměný výchozí stav"), which in a quantum text reads as "initial state" rather than a reference/comparison distribution — "náhodné referenční rozdělení" would be right. VQE is also split within the file: English "Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE)" at the top vs. the calque "Variačního kvantového vlastního řešitele" at the figure discussion; plus two stylistic slips ("zajistili jednotnost dat napříč daty", "efektivně identifikuje eficientní investiční strategie") and the non-standard passive "byl zvolený počet jedinců populace".

examples.source: the number of qubits in the circuit / requires more circuit executions / configurations of resolution qubits, ansatz circuits
examples.suggested: počtem qubitů v obvodu / vyžaduje více spuštění obvodů / rozlišovacích qubitů, ansatzových obvodů
examples.translation: počtem qubitů v Circuit / vyžaduje více spuštění Circuit / rozlišovacích Qubitů, Circuit ansatzů
examples.why: 'Circuit' is left in English and undeclined inside Czech sentences (and 'Qubitů' is capitalized against the lowercase 'qubitů' used everywhere else) — a glossary leak that breaks Czech grammar, though the concept stays recognizable.

examples.source: compare your results ... against a random baseline / the noisy baseline exhibits a broader distribution
examples.suggested: porovnej své výsledky ... s náhodnou referenční hodnotou / zašuměné referenční rozdělení vykazuje širší rozdělení
examples.translation: porovnej své výsledky ... s náhodným výchozím stavem / zašuměný výchozí stav vykazuje širší rozdělení
examples.why: 'Výchozí stav' is the standard Czech for 'initial state', a distinct quantum concept; the English means a random-sampling reference distribution, which the surrounding 'náhodné rozdělení' only partly rescues.

examples.source: Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) ... our Variational Quantum Eigensolver (post-processed with SQD) approach
examples.suggested: náš přístup VQE (s post-zpracováním pomocí SQD)
examples.translation: algoritmus Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) ... náš přístup Variačního kvantového vlastního řešitele (po zpracování pomocí SQD)
examples.why: The term is introduced in English and then re-rendered as the calque 'vlastní řešitel'; 'post-processing' likewise flips from 'post-zpracování' (l. 29) to 'po zpracování' — within-file inconsistency, not a false concept.

examples.source: to ensure uniformity across dates, we have filled non-trading days with the closing price
examples.suggested: ...abychom zajistili jednotnost napříč jednotlivými dny
examples.translation: jsme dny bez obchodování doplnili závěrečnou cenou z předchozího dostupného data, abychom zajistili jednotnost dat napříč daty
examples.why: 'jednotnost dat napříč daty' stacks 'dat/daty' in one clause; a native technical writer would not repeat the root twice with two different meanings.

examples.source: effectively identifies efficient investment strategies
examples.suggested: spolehlivě nachází efektivní investiční strategie
examples.translation: efektivně identifikuje eficientní investiční strategie
examples.why: 'eficientní' is a rare Latinate borrowing next to the ordinary 'efektivně' — reads as a translator dodging the repetition rather than idiomatic Czech.

examples.source: the chosen population size was based on previous experiments
examples.suggested: byl počet jedinců populace (`population_size`) zvolen na základě předchozích experimentů
examples.translation: byl zvolený počet jedinců populace (`population_size`) na základě předchozích experimentů
examples.why: Passive voice needs the short participle 'zvolen'; 'byl zvolený' is a non-standard colloquial form in written technical prose.

editor_note: No semantic drift, no hallucinations, and no inverted or softened claims — the German says what the English says, and the informal "du" register holds throughout ("Weitere Informationen findest du…", "Erfahre, wie du OpenQASM-Code … generierst", "Lies…", "Besuche…"). Domain terminology is correct and consistent (Quantenschaltungen, Gates, Messungen, Transpilierung, maschinenunabhängige Programmierschnittstelle, imperative Programmiersprache). What a native technical editor would still change are calques and one agreement slip: "das OpenQASM 3-Papier" for the OpenQASM 3 *paper* (German uses "Paper", "Artikel" or "Veröffentlichung"; "Papier" is the physical material); "Fehlersuche von Quantenprozessoren" (must be "Fehlersuche an/bei Quantenprozessoren" — the genitive works for Charakterisierung/Validierung but not Fehlersuche); "Feed-Forward-Flusskontrolle" for feed-forward flow control (in this control-flow sense German says Ablaufsteuerung/Kontrollfluss; "Flusskontrolle" is the networking term); "um die Optimierungs- und Synthesealgorithmen zu informieren", a literal rendering of "to inform the algorithms"; and "für Anweisungen" for "for instructions", where "Anweisungen" reads as commands rather than a how-to guide. All are stylistic/idiomatic, none would lead a learner to a false belief.

examples.source: The introduction to the OpenQASM 3 paper[^1] gives examples:
examples.suggested: Die Einleitung des OpenQASM-3-Papers[^1] nennt Beispiele:
examples.translation: Die Einleitung zum OpenQASM 3-Papier[^1] gibt Beispiele:
examples.why: "Papier" is the physical sheet of paper; a scientific publication is "Paper" (loanword), "Artikel" or "Veröffentlichung". Classic translationese a German researcher would never write.

examples.source: …circuits intended to characterize, validate, or debug quantum processors.
examples.suggested: …die der Charakterisierung, Validierung oder Fehlersuche an Quantenprozessoren dienen.
examples.translation: …Schaltungen beschreiben, die zur Charakterisierung, Validierung oder Fehlersuche von Quantenprozessoren gedacht sind.
examples.why: "Fehlersuche von X" is ungrammatical — Fehlersuche takes "an/bei", not the genitive that Charakterisierung and Validierung share. The chained noun phrase breaks on the third item.

examples.source: …extensions including classical feed-forward flow control, gate modifiers, and pulse implementations.
examples.suggested: …Erweiterungen wie klassische Feed-Forward-Ablaufsteuerung (Kontrollfluss), Gate-Modifikatoren und Puls-Implementierungen.
examples.translation: …Erweiterungen einschließlich klassischer Feed-Forward-Flusskontrolle, Gate-Modifikatoren und Puls-Implementierungen.
examples.why: "Flusskontrolle" is the German term for data-rate flow control in networking; program control flow is "Kontrollfluss"/"Ablaufsteuerung". Recognizable but the wrong established term.

examples.source: …high-level information recorded in the intermediate representations to inform the optimization and synthesis algorithms.
examples.suggested: …die in die Optimierungs- und Synthesealgorithmen einfließen / als Grundlage für diese Algorithmen dienen.
examples.translation: …High-Level-Informationen, die in den Zwischendarstellungen aufgezeichnet sind, um die Optimierungs- und Synthesealgorithmen zu informieren.
examples.why: "Algorithmen informieren" is a literal calque of English "to inform"; in German "informieren" means to notify a person, so the sentence reads oddly mechanical.

examples.source: (see [OpenQASM 2 and Qiskit] and [OpenQASM 3 and Qiskit] for instructions).
examples.suggested: (eine Anleitung dazu findest du unter [OpenQASM 2 und Qiskit] und [OpenQASM 3 und Qiskit]).
examples.translation: (siehe [OpenQASM 2 und Qiskit] und [OpenQASM 3 und Qiskit] für Anweisungen).
examples.why: "Anweisungen" means commands/directives; "instructions" in the how-to sense is "Anleitung". Also, "OpenQASM ist das gemeinsame Austauschformat unter unabhängigen Quantensoftware-Tools" in the same block should be "zwischen", not "unter".

editor_note: No semantic drift: every claim, quantity and caveat matches the English (unbiased/biased contrast for ZNE vs PEC, quadratic-vs-linear noise accumulation, the ~3x overhead, "la precisión del resultado supere la precisión solicitada", "escala cuadráticamente con $\gamma$"), and the core terminology is correct and internally consistent ("valores esperados", "puertas de dos qubits", "plegado digital de puertas", twirling kept in English throughout, "sobrecarga" for overhead, informal tú everywhere: "Ten en cuenta", "puedes", "Consulta"). What a native editor would still change is small and local: a leftover translator's gloss in the DD diagram paragraph — "se mapea en una secuencia temporal (programación) de pulsos de microondas", where the parenthetical doubles the noun and then the next sentence reuses only "la misma programación"; a gender-agreement slip in the PEA section, "El plegado de puertas ... pero puede ser imprecisa" (should be "impreciso", since the English attributes the inaccuracy to gate folding, not to "una manera"); the calqued preposition in "los circuitos se ejecutan a cada factor de ruido" / "se ejecuta múltiples veces a diferentes tasas de ruido" (Spanish wants "en cada factor" / "con diferentes tasas"); and "Al igual que en el twirling de puertas estándar", which can be misparsed as twirling of *standard gates* rather than standard *gate twirling*. None of these would mislead a learner. Note also that this file consistently uses "el primitivo Estimator" while the wider es corpus leans to "la primitiva" (235 vs 111 occurrences) — a cross-file convention question, not a within-file defect.

examples.source: The abstract circuit on the left is mapped onto a microwave pulse schedule on the top right. The bottom right depicts the same schedule...
