examples.source: The figure below (courtesy: [\[7\]](#references)) shows an example of wire cutting
examples.suggested: Figura de mai jos (prin amabilitatea lui [\[7\]](#references)) arată un exemplu de tăiere a firelor
examples.translation: Figura de mai jos (cu amabilitatea: [\[7\]](#references)) arată un exemplu de tăiere a firelor
examples.why: 'cu amabilitatea:' is a literal calque of the English credit line and reads as a truncated phrase in Romanian; the idiom is 'prin amabilitatea lui X' (or simply 'sursa: X').

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material:
examples.suggested: Dacă ți s-a părut interesant acest material, s-ar putea să te intereseze și următoarele:
examples.translation: Dacă ai găsit această lucrare interesantă, s-ar putea să fii interesat de următorul material:
examples.why: 'lucrare' denotes a scientific paper or thesis, not a tutorial page — an odd referent right next to a reference list full of actual papers. 'Dacă ai găsit … interesantă' is also a calque of 'if you found X interesting'; Romanian prefers 'dacă ți s-a părut interesant'.

examples.source: To reconstruct the expectation value of the original circuit, we require the observable in the `SparsePauliOp` format. … reconstruct the expectation value of the uncut circuit
examples.suggested: Use 'a reconstrui' in both places (reconstruim / pentru a reconstrui), matching the noun 'reconstrucție' used at line ~229
examples.translation: Pentru a reconstitui valoarea de așteptare a circuitului original… / …reconstruim valoarea de așteptare a circuitului netăiat
examples.why: The same operation — the addon's reconstruction step, named `reconstruct_expectation_values` in the code — is rendered with two different verbs within one file ('a reconstitui' vs 'a reconstrui'), while the noun form is 'reconstrucție'. Both verbs are defensible in isolation; the inconsistency is what a native editor would remove.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats, and the physics prose is correct and idiomatic ("baza computațională", "stările proprii Pauli-$Z$", "o măsurătoare produce 0 sau 1, în funcție de suprapunerea cu..."); informal "tu" holds consistently ("Află cum", "îl poți _măsura_", "Folosește metoda", "când folosești Qiskit Runtime"). Two things a Romanian technical editor would still change. First, English title-case/orthography leaks into the Romanian: the common noun "circuit" is capitalized mid-sentence ("Aplicarea unei măsurători într-un Circuit", "a aplica măsurători într-un Circuit") and, worse, declined with a hyphen as if it were a foreign proper noun — "la mijlocul Circuit-ului" instead of the correct "la mijlocul circuitului"; the title "Măsurarea Qubiților" likewise capitalizes "qubiți" per English convention. Second, "numărul de qubiți non-inactivi care sunt măsurați" is a double-negative calque of "non-idle qubits" that no native writer would produce — the same sentence's own earlier phrasing ("care nu sunt inactivi") or simply "qubiți activi" reads far better. Neither would mislead a learner.

examples.source: Apply a measurement to a circuit / Mid-circuit measurements
examples.suggested: Aplicarea unei măsurători într-un circuit / Măsurători la mijlocul circuitului
examples.translation: Aplicarea unei măsurători într-un Circuit / Măsurători la mijlocul Circuit-ului
examples.why: "circuit" is an ordinary Romanian common noun: it is not capitalized mid-sentence, and it takes the enclitic article directly (circuitului), never hyphenated as "Circuit-ului". The hyphen+capital treats it as an untranslated foreign word and reads as raw English formatting carried over; the same title-case habit shows in the page title "Măsurarea Qubiților".

examples.source: This method creates a new `ClassicalRegister` with a size equal to the number of non-idle qubits being measured.
examples.suggested: ...cu dimensiunea egală cu numărul de qubiți activi (care nu sunt inactivi) care se măsoară.
examples.translation: Această metodă creează un nou `ClassicalRegister` cu o dimensiune egală cu numărul de qubiți non-inactivi care sunt măsurați.
examples.why: "non-inactivi" is a literal calque of "non-idle" and stacks two negations in a way Romanian avoids; the very same paragraph already renders the idea naturally as "care nu sunt inactivi", so the file is also internally inconsistent about how it says it. Meaning survives, but the phrasing is unmistakably machine-shaped.

editor_note: All load-bearing facts survive intact (400 นาที minimum, Nighthawk 120 qubits, transpiled two-qubit depth ~30, ~30% more complex circuits, ~10× error rates, 30-120 นาที per run), the "what QC is and is not" paragraph is faithful including the NISQ noise/scale caveat, and the informal register holds with no ครับ/ค่ะ. The defects are calques and small drifts, not false teaching. Worst is the Resources lead-in: "The following are good candidate organizations for QC funding" becomes "ต่อไปนี้เป็นองค์กรที่เป็นผู้สมัครรับทุน QC ที่ดี", which flips the role — it says these orgs are good grant *applicants/recipients*, when the table below (NSF, DOE, DARPA, NQCC) lists the funders you apply *to*; the table itself disambiguates, so it stops short of misleading, but it should read "หน่วยงานที่ให้ทุน QC". Also: "call out" is calqued twice as "ถูกเรียกออก" / "เรียกงานเบื้องต้นด้านบน" (near-meaningless as a checklist instruction; should be "ระบุ/เน้น"), "When we allow for experimentation" becomes "เมื่อเราอนุญาตให้มีการทดลอง" (= "when we permit", not "when we account for"), "Draw connections" is literal "วาดความเชื่อมโยง", "asset type" is the financial "ประเภทสินทรัพย์", and everyday words are left in English where Thai exists ("Practices ทั่วไป", "optimize ความเหมาะสม").

examples.source: The following are good candidate organizations for QC funding.
examples.suggested: ต่อไปนี้เป็นหน่วยงานที่น่าสนใจสำหรับการขอทุนด้าน QC
examples.translation: ต่อไปนี้เป็นองค์กรที่เป็นผู้สมัครรับทุน QC ที่ดี
examples.why: 'ผู้สมัครรับทุน' means grant applicant/recipient, inverting the role: the table lists agencies that GIVE funding (NSF, DOE, DARPA, NQCC), not organizations that apply for it. Reader recovers from the table columns, but the sentence asserts the opposite relationship.

examples.source: (these are called out in the proposal itself) / Call out the preliminary work above.
examples.suggested: (สิ่งเหล่านี้จะถูกระบุไว้ใน proposal เอง) / เน้นย้ำงานเบื้องต้นที่กล่าวถึงข้างต้น
examples.translation: (สิ่งเหล่านี้ถูกเรียกออกใน proposal เอง) / เรียกงานเบื้องต้นด้านบน
examples.why: 'call out' is calqued as 'เรียกออก' (call outward), which carries no usable meaning in Thai and can even read as 'excluded'. As a bare checklist item 'เรียกงานเบื้องต้นด้านบน' is unparseable to a native reader.

examples.source: When we allow for experimentation, benchmarking of your problem, and multiple attempts, this time range is consistent with the aforementioned minimum.
examples.suggested: เมื่อเผื่อเวลาสำหรับการทดลอง การทำ benchmarking กับปัญหาของคุณ และการรันซ้ำหลายครั้ง ...
examples.translation: เมื่อเราอนุญาตให้มีการทดลอง benchmarking ของปัญหาของคุณ และการพยายามหลายครั้ง ช่วงเวลานี้สอดคล้องกับขั้นต่ำที่กล่าวถึงข้างต้น
examples.why: 'allow for' = account/budget for, not grant permission. 'อนุญาต' turns a budgeting argument about QPU minutes into IBM permitting the user to experiment.

examples.source: Draw connections between academia and industry, and broader impacts generally.
examples.suggested: เชื่อมโยงภาควิชาการเข้ากับภาคอุตสาหกรรม
examples.translation: วาดความเชื่อมโยงระหว่างวิชาการและอุตสาหกรรม
examples.why: 'วาด' is draw-with-a-pencil; Thai does not collocate it with ความเชื่อมโยง. Pure English-syntax calque in a sentence repeated twice.

examples.source: They have been sorted first by topic and then by asset type...
examples.suggested: ...แล้วจึงตามประเภทของเอกสาร/แหล่งข้อมูล
examples.translation: ได้ถูกจัดเรียงก่อนตามหัวข้อแล้วตามประเภทสินทรัพย์
examples.why: 'สินทรัพย์' is the financial sense of asset; here 'asset type' means document type (government report, peer-reviewed paper, industry analysis). On a funding page the financial reading is actively distracting.

examples.source: many grants will at least have a requirement (if not a focus) on education... / Each grant writer will obviously produce their own original proposal.
examples.suggested: หลายทุนจะมีข้อกำหนดอย่างน้อยที่สุด (ถ้าไม่ถึงกับเป็นจุดเน้น)... / แน่นอนว่าผู้เขียนแต่ละคนย่อมเขียนข้อเสนอของตนเองขึ้นมาเอง
examples.translation: หลายทุนจะมีข้อกำหนด (ถ้าไม่ใช่จุดเน้น) ด้านการศึกษา... / ผู้เขียนขอทุนแต่ละคนจะสร้าง proposal ต้นฉบับของตนเอง
examples.why: 'at least' and 'obviously' are both dropped, flattening the English's concessive framing; 'proposal ต้นฉบับ' also reads as 'manuscript' rather than 'an original proposal of one's own'.

editor_note: The math content is faithful throughout and core terminology is solid and consistent (ผลคูณภายใน for inner product, เซตออร์โธนอร์มอล / ฐานออร์โธนอร์มอล, เมทริกซ์ยูนิทารี, เมทริกซ์เฮอร์มิเชียน, อิเดมโพเทนต์, การวัดแบบโปรเจกทีฟ, Qubit kept in English), register is casual with no ครับ/ค่ะ. What a native technical editor would change: "positive definiteness" is rendered ความเป็นนิยามบวก, a false-friend calque treating "definite" as "definition" (นิยาม) instead of แน่นอน — the standard Thai is ความเป็นบวกแน่นอน; the property itself is stated correctly just above, so it misnames rather than misteaches. There is a clear typo, ผลคูณภายิน for ผลคูณภายใน, in the conjugate-linearity paragraph. Two further calques: "This argument generalizes…" becomes การโต้แย้งนี้ขยายได้ (โต้แย้ง = to dispute/object, not a line of reasoning — การให้เหตุผลนี้ is wanted), and "Pictorially" becomes the literal ในรูปภาพ ("in the picture"). Finally, "the second-to-last equality" is rendered ความเท่ากันสองขั้นก่อนสุดท้าย, which reads as the third-to-last and points the learner at the wrong step of the Π² derivation (รองสุดท้าย is the right pointer). Also a mild split on "orthogonal": ตั้งฉาก for the adjective vs. ออร์โธโกนอล in เซตออร์โธโกนอล — defensible but slightly uneven.

examples.source: This property of the inner product is sometimes referred to as _positive definiteness_.
examples.suggested: สมบัตินี้ของผลคูณภายในบางครั้งเรียกว่า _ความเป็นบวกแน่นอน_ (positive definiteness)
examples.translation: สมบัตินี้ของผลคูณภายในบางครั้งเรียกว่า _ความเป็นนิยามบวก_
examples.why: นิยาม means 'definition'; 'definite' here means แน่นอน. A false-friend calque that gives the property a wrong Thai name (the property itself is stated correctly, so it misnames rather than misteaches).

examples.source: Combining this fact with conjugate symmetry reveals that the inner product is _conjugate linear_ in the first argument.
examples.suggested: …แสดงให้เห็นว่าผลคูณภายในเป็น _เชิงเส้นเชิงคอนจูเกต_ ในอาร์กิวเมนต์แรก
examples.translation: การรวมข้อเท็จจริงนี้กับความสมมาตรเชิงคอนจูเกตแสดงให้เห็นว่าผลคูณภายินเป็น _เชิงเส้นเชิงคอนจูเกต_ ในอาร์กิวเมนต์แรก
examples.why: Typo: ผลคูณภายิน is missing the ใ — the key term of the whole page is misspelled here, though rendered correctly everywhere else.

examples.source: where the orthonormality of {|ψ_1⟩,…,|ψ_m⟩} implies the second-to-last equality.
examples.suggested: …ทำให้ความเท่ากันรองสุดท้ายเป็นจริง
examples.translation: โดยความเป็นออร์โธนอร์มอลของ $\{\vert \psi_1\rangle,\ldots,\vert \psi_m\rangle\}$ ทำให้ความเท่ากันสองขั้นก่อนสุดท้ายเป็นจริง
examples.why: 'สองขั้นก่อนสุดท้าย' reads as two steps before the last (i.e. third-to-last), pointing at the wrong line of the Π² derivation; orthonormality is used at the second-to-last equality (รองสุดท้าย).

examples.source: This argument generalizes to unitary matrices of any size. … Pictorially, we can always find a unitary matrix having this form:
examples.suggested: การให้เหตุผลนี้ขยายได้กับเมทริกซ์ยูนิทารีทุกขนาด … เขียนเป็นภาพได้ว่า เราสามารถหาเมทริกซ์ยูนิทารีที่มีรูปแบบนี้ได้เสมอ
examples.translation: การโต้แย้งนี้ขยายได้กับเมทริกซ์ยูนิทารีทุกขนาด … ในรูปภาพ เราสามารถหาเมทริกซ์ยูนิทารีที่มีรูปแบบนี้ได้เสมอ
examples.why: Two literal calques: การโต้แย้ง means a dispute/objection, not a mathematical argument; ในรูปภาพ means 'in the picture' rather than 'pictorially/schematically'. Both read as MT, not as a Thai technical writer.

examples.source: Orthogonal and orthonormal sets / two vectors are said to be *orthogonal* / an *orthogonal set*
examples.suggested: pick one convention — either ตั้งฉาก throughout (เซตตั้งฉาก) or ออร์โธโกนอล throughout
examples.translation: เซตออร์โธโกนอลและออร์โธนอร์มอล / เรียกว่า *ตั้งฉาก* กัน / เรียกว่า *เซตออร์โธโกนอล*
examples.why: 'Orthogonal' alternates between the native ตั้งฉาก and the transliteration ออร์โธโกนอล within a few lines; both are correct and the concept stays identifiable, but the split is uneven for a single section.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveats, correct "anim na pangunahing yugto", the six stage descriptions all match, and "Ang mas mataas na antas ay nagbubunga ng mas na-optimize na mga circuit ngunit mas matagal ang transpilation" preserves the trade-off. Register is correctly informal (iyong/mo/ka, no po/opo) and core terms are kept in English consistently (qubit, gate, circuit, backend, pass, transpile; noise→ingay everywhere). What a native technical editor would change: (1) "connectivity" is rendered as "koneksyon" twice ("koneksyon ng hardware", "koneksyon ng QPU") — that reads as "connection", not the network-topology sense; "connectivity"/"pagkakakonekta" is the conventional rendering, though the "(coupling map)" gloss keeps it recognizable; (2) double-plural "mga passes" (mga + English -s) appears four times while "mga pass" is used correctly elsewhere in the same file — an internal inconsistency; (3) a few stiff spots, notably "Para sa isang mas simple, ngunit hindi gaanong mako-customize, na paraan ng paggamit ng Transpiler" where the comma-stranded "na paraan" and the verb-form "mako-customize" for the adjective "customizable" read as calqued English word order. None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: comply with the constraints specified by the connectivity of the hardware, that is, the target's CouplingMap
examples.suggested: sumusunod sa mga limitasyong tinukoy ng connectivity ng hardware, iyon ay, ang CouplingMap ng target
examples.translation: sumusunod sa mga hadlang na tinukoy ng koneksyon ng hardware, iyon ay, ang CouplingMap ng target
examples.why: "koneksyon" is the everyday word for a single connection, not the topology sense of connectivity; "hadlang" (obstacle/hindrance) is also a weak fit for engineering "constraints" — "limitasyon"/"restriksyon" is the standard term. Recognizable given the CouplingMap gloss, so not misleading.

examples.source: combine them with other existing passes / one or more passes / hardware-aware scheduling passes
examples.suggested: ... sa iba pang kasalukuyang mga pass / isa o higit pang mga pass / anumang hardware-aware scheduling na mga pass
examples.translation: pagsasama ng mga ito sa iba pang mga kasalukuyang passes / isa o higit pang passes / anumang hardware-aware scheduling passes
examples.why: Tagalog marks plural with "mga", so "mga passes" is a double plural; the same file already uses the correct "mga custom na pass" (line 49), making it an internal inconsistency an editor would unify.

examples.source: For a simpler, but less customizable, "out-of-the-box" way to use the transpiler, use the qiskit.compiler.transpile function.
examples.suggested: Para sa mas simple ngunit hindi gaanong nako-customize na paraan ng paggamit ng transpiler nang "out-of-the-box", gamitin ang function na qiskit.compiler.transpile.
examples.translation: Para sa isang mas simple, ngunit hindi gaanong mako-customize, na paraan ng paggamit ng Transpiler "out-of-the-box", gamitin ang function na qiskit.compiler.transpile.
examples.why: The English appositive commas are carried over literally, stranding "na paraan" after a comma — a native writer would not break the ligature that way; "mako-customize" is also a contemplative-aspect verb standing in for an adjective. Stiff, not wrong.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every conditional and quantity survives intact (SWAP→"tatlong CNOT gate", Toffoli→"hanggang anim na CNOT gate", "Ginagamit lamang ang pass na ito sa mga optimization level 1, 2, at 3 kung hindi mahanap ang perpektong layout", "labis na mahal para kalkulahin para sa lahat maliban sa pinakamaliit na mga quantum device"), domain terms are kept in English and used consistently (qubit, gate, circuit, backend, layout, routing, depth, transpilation), and the informal register holds with no po/opo. What a native technical editor would change is surface polish: an aspect slip plus an invented "again" in "para maililipat ang mga qubit state hanggang sa maging magkatabing muli sila" (EN has no "again"; should be "para mailipat … hanggang maging magkatabi sila"); "makasaysayang gawi" for "historical behavior", which in Tagalog reads as "historic/momentous" rather than "legacy"; "maraming gawain para sa pag-optimize" for "many routines" (software routines → "gawain" = tasks) and the limp "hindi masyadong magagawa" for "not much can be done" (native: "walang gaanong magagawa"); and mid-sentence capitalization of the common nouns "Backend" (lines 51, 134, 179, 230, 261) and "Transpiler" (line 258) where English has them lowercase. Also two completed-aspect slips describing habitual behavior: "ibinalik ang na-transform na circuit" (should be "ibinabalik") and "inihambing ang mga `optimization_levels`" (should be "inihahambing"). None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: one or more SWAP gates must be inserted into the circuit to move the qubit states around until they are adjacent on the device gate map
examples.suggested: kailangang maglagay ng isa o higit pang SWAP gate sa circuit para mailipat ang mga qubit state hanggang maging magkatabi sila sa device gate map
examples.translation: kailangang maglagay ng isa o higit pang SWAP gate sa circuit para maililipat ang mga qubit state hanggang sa maging magkatabing muli sila sa device gate map
examples.why: Two slips: after "para" Tagalog takes the infinitive "mailipat", not the contemplative "maililipat"; and "muli" ("again") is not in the English and falsely implies the qubits were adjacent before.

examples.source: This is historical behavior only used in optimzation_level=1 to try to find a perfect layout.
examples.suggested: Ito ay lumang gawi (pamana ng dating disenyo) na ginagamit lamang sa `optimzation_level=1` …
examples.translation: Ito ay makasaysayang gawi na ginagamit lamang sa `optimzation_level=1` para subukang mahanap ang perpektong layout.
examples.why: "Makasaysayan" in Tagalog means "historic / of great historical significance", not "legacy, kept for backward compatibility", which is what "historical behavior" means here. Recognizable but the wrong shade.

examples.source: Fortunately, there are many routines for optimizing circuits by either combining or eliminating gates. … In other cases, not much can be done
examples.suggested: … maraming pamamaraan/rutina para i-optimize ang mga circuit … Sa ibang kaso, walang gaanong magagawa
examples.translation: Sa kabutihang palad, maraming gawain para sa pag-optimize ng mga circuit sa pamamagitan ng pagsasama o pag-aalis ng mga gate. … Sa ibang kaso, hindi masyadong magagawa
examples.why: "Gawain" reads as "tasks/chores", not software routines; and "hindi masyadong magagawa" is an unfinished-sounding calque of "not much can be done" that a native writer would render "walang gaanong magagawa".

examples.source: the backend a circuit will be sent to … The transpiler inserted Delay instructions
examples.suggested: ng backend kung saan ipapadala ang circuit … Naglagay ang transpiler ng mga tagubiling `Delay`
examples.translation: ng Backend kung saan ipapadala ang circuit … Naglagay ang Transpiler ng mga tagubiling `Delay`
examples.why: "Backend" and "transpiler" are common nouns, lowercase in the English throughout; capitalizing them mid-sentence in five places reads as a proper name / product and is inconsistent with the rest of the file's English-term handling.

examples.source: most layout and routing algorithms are only designed to work with single- and two-qubit gates
examples.suggested: karamihan sa mga layout at routing algorithm ay idinisenyo lamang para gumana sa single- at two-qubit gate
examples.translation: karamihan sa mga layout at routing algorithm ay idinisenyo lamang para magtrabaho sa single- at two-qubit gate
examples.why: "Magtrabaho" is human labour ("to hold a job"); for an algorithm operating on gates a native technical writer writes "gumana sa" or "tumakbo sa". Grammatical but audibly calqued from "work with".

editor_note: Faithful, natural Ukrainian with consistent terminology (instance→інстанс, backends→бекенди, allow-list→"список дозволених імен бекендів", fair-share scheduler→"планувальник справедливого розподілу"); the "provision" sense is anchored for the reader by "Створення (підготовка) нового інстансу ресурсу" and used consistently, informal "ти" holds throughout ("звернись до документації", "зверни увагу"), and every numeric/default detail matches (Open Plan → 10 хвилин, `["ANY"]` → всі бекенди, `[]` → жодних бекендів, Pay-As-You-Go caveat retained).
